title: I made a 16-bit RPG armor and shield asset pack (51 items across 3 tiers: Steel, Mythril, Unique) – What do you think?
author: LoreCraft_Assets
selftext:
Hey everyone! I just finished putting together my second asset pack under the brand LoreCraft Asset—a 16-bit coarse retro pixel art armor and shield collection designed for 2D indie RPGs and inventory UI.



It features 51 total items divided into 3 progressive tiers (Steel, Mythril, and Unique), complete with transparent PNGs. 



I wanted to keep the style clean with bold outlines so it's easy to drop straight into a game engine. Let me know what you think of the design! 



If you're interested in checking it out or using it for your projects, it's currently live on my [itch.io](http://itch.io) page [https://lorecraft-assets.itch.io/16-bit-fantasy-armor-shield-pack-51-rpg-pixel-art-assets-3-tiers](https://lorecraft-assets.itch.io/16-bit-fantasy-armor-shield-pack-51-rpg-pixel-art-assets-3-tiers)

comments.author: Writer_IT
comments.body:
2 constructive criticism from a first look at the page, if you'd like to evaluate them moving forward.

1) unfortunately, the assets have that clear "ai feel" that people are current hating. They don't have any visual distinction from the ones we're currently seeing in a flood of debatable games, and this will be a turn off for many.
You should try to refine the workflow to reach some dostinctiveness.

2) for what i can understand, they are just static images. Like that, they have little use in a game. The real issue, and the party where you could try to focus of you'd like to create della le assets, is to refine the generated set to support composition and animation.

Before ai, they would have had a place for card games and such, but now that's a market, as above, full of low effort games, and people building them would presumably try to generate their own low effort art / grab free ones without paying for a set, or make a lot of effort into trying to reach a distinctive art style to differentiate from the mass

replies.author: Writer_IT
replies.body: PS i re-read your description. If you drew them, and not generated them, as above the images you posted have an ai feel. So if you know how to draw, maybe try some more vivid colors, and offer a composition of asset on characters, that could work better
